title: Cold-start orientation: a fresh cheap worker finds the entrypoint and next action
summary: A context-free Haiku worker, given only 'continue Orchestrator development using the canonical workflow', located the entrypoint, policy, status manifest, next improvement (IMP-0003) and worker class. 5/5 fields correct against the repository state. Verifies bootstrap deliverable: the next prompt does not need the bootstrap prompt.
